topic_title: Question about using self-play / human-play logs as external data

messages.content_html:
Hi organizers,

First of all, thank you very much for hosting this competition. I really appreciate the effort that has gone into making this possible, and I have been enjoying the competition a lot. It is especially exciting to work on Pokémon TCG in this format, and I am grateful for the opportunity.

I would like to ask for clarification about the use of gameplay logs for training.

Suppose a participant or team creates additional gameplay data outside of the provided competition data, for example:

  • logs generated by manually playing Pokémon TCG ourselves
  • human-play demonstrations created by our own team
  • battle logs obtained from external Pokémon TCG platforms such as Pokémon TCG Live (PTCGL), assuming we have the right to use them.

Would such data be allowed to be used for pretraining, behavior cloning, imitation learning, or other training purposes without making the data publicly available?

My understanding from the rules is that any data not provided on the competition website would likely be considered External Data. If so, I would like to confirm whether such data must be made publicly available and equally accessible to all participants through the Kaggle community in order to be used.

I also have a follow-up question about timing. If external data needs to be made public, is there any deadline by which it must be published? For example, would it be acceptable to publish the data very late in the competition, such as one hour before the final submission deadline, or would that be considered against the intended fairness of the competition?

In short, could you please clarify:

  1. Are self-generated human-play logs allowed for training?
  2. Are PTCGL or other external battle logs allowed, assuming the participant has the necessary rights to use them?
  3. If these (1,2) are considered External Data, must they be publicly shared with all participants?
  4. If public sharing is required, is there a minimum period before the competition deadline during which the data must be available?

Thank you for your clarification.

Hi there,

Those datasets are allowed for use in training and aren't considered a violation of the rules.
